name: Crane Ledger
tagline: Headless double-entry ledger. 90 MCP tools. OAuth 2.1 or API key.
description:
Crane Ledger is a headless double-entry ledger of record over Streamable HTTP at https://api.craneledger.ai/mcp.

90 MCP tools for accounts, journals, invoices, bills, reports, and draft/approve writes. Includes purchase_credits, start_x402_credit_purchase, complete_x402_credit_purchase, get_credit_balance, and get_credit_packages.

Auth is OAuth 2.1 (discover via GET https://api.craneledger.ai/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource, DCR at https://auth.craneledger.ai/register, consent at https://craneledger.ai/oauth/consent, scopes ledger:read ledger:write ledger:admin) or a Bearer ha_live_ / ha_test_ API key. Org scope comes from the token or key. 500 free credits at https://craneledger.ai/auth/signin.

install.notes: OAuth 2.1 is preferred (no pre-shared key). API-key clients can pass --header "Authorization: Bearer ha_live_..." or ha_test_.... Credits tools stay: purchase_credits and x402 top-up.
